prompt: Implement unique_slug(title, existing) in slugs.py using the existing normalize helper. Return the normalized slug when unused. Otherwise use the smallest available numeric suffix starting at -2. Empty normalized titles use item. existing is a set of slug strings and must not be mutated.
orientation: Inspect repository files and discover the visible unittest command. All configurations receive the same orientation opportunity.
acceptance: All original visible and held-out tests pass; no test or infrastructure changes allowed.
